name: WISEA J140717.48-050726.1, SN 2020esm field (Hubble)
blurb: WISEA J140717.48-050726.1, a star-forming irregular galaxy that hosted the Type Ia supernova SN 2020esm, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2020esm-hubble
story: This star-forming irregular galaxy hosted SN 2020esm, one of the best-studied "super-Chandrasekhar" Type Ia supernovae. In its first days the explosion showed a nearly pure carbon and oxygen atmosphere.

claims.text: SN 2020esm's host is the star-forming irregular galaxy WISEA J140717.48-050726.1
SN 2020esm is one of the best-studied super-Chandrasekhar Type Ia supernovae
Its first spectra reveal a nearly pure carbon/oxygen atmosphere in the first days after explosion
Blast classifies 2020esm as SNIa-SC at the program's position
